deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints
MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings, 3 per quarter, with developer and agent coverage
request.recipient: Intersect on behalf of TxPipe, with withdrawal to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including developer and AI-agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is presented as a framework that lets each protocol be described once with a verified interface definition that produces documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
Through Catalyst Fund 14, TxPipe has put the developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at https://tx3.land.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, plus development of an MCP server and skill framework as shared infrastructure for protocols on the registry.

The proposer states that there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and making cross-protocol composability impractical.
The proposal states that agent-driven on-chain activity requires shared interfaces where agents express auditable intents while underlying transactions remain deterministic.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The document says independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 expansion by TxPipe, submitted by Intersect, covering protocol onboardings, SDK/RPC/documentation infrastructure, agent-facing MCP and skills work, administration fees, and smart-contract-based treasury management with cited governance and audit references.
